observations.name: blocked
observations.detail: No active licensed threat feed exists before the supplemental at-members-readback experiment; it supplies a self-authored licensed input and polls the real 300-second failure cadence. Sentinel scan covers DNS only, not a successful member URL flow. Raw usage/rollup purge, file-content scans, retained backup expiry and representative full-qname/URL privacy require the missing fixtures; no complete privacy pass is claimed.
